Avoid using `Intl.Collator` with an undefined locale for sorting, as it can introduce locale-sensitive discrepancies across different runtime environments. Instead, use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison to ensure locale-independent, deterministic ordering.

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Sort the fixture cases lexicographically by `case_id` using strict byte-order comparison to prevent diff churn and maintain consistency across generated artifacts.

```javascript
    cases: [
      fixtureCase('included_text_question_internal_projection', included, {
        read_model_row_presence: 'included',
        rag_projection_class: 'included',
        student_display_class: 'rights_display_blocked',
        accepted_truth_allowed: true,
      }),
      fixtureCase('visual_placeholder_is_downgraded_not_indexed', downgraded, {
        read_model_row_presence: 'included',
        rag_projection_class: 'downgraded',
        student_display_class: 'rights_display_blocked',
        accepted_truth_allowed: false,
      }),
      fixtureCase('missing_required_visual_receipt_is_excluded_from_rag_projection', excluded, {
        read_model_row_presence: 'included',
        rag_projection_class: 'excluded',
        student_display_class: 'rights_display_blocked',
        accepted_truth_allowed: false,
      }),
      fixtureCase('low_method_confidence_downgrades_diagnostic_language_only', lowConfidence, {
        read_model_row_presence: 'included',
        rag_projection_class: 'included',
        diagnostic_language_class: 'low_confidence_downgraded',
        question_presence_affected_by_method_confidence: false,
        accepted_truth_allowed: true,
      }),
      fixtureCase('raw_vlm_candidate_cannot_become_accepted_truth', rawCandidate, {
        read_model_row_presence: 'included',
        rag_projection_class: 'candidate_only',
        student_display_class: 'candidate_only',
        accepted_truth_allowed: false,
      }),
      fixtureCase('unreviewed_visual_asset_cannot_become_accepted_truth', unreviewedVisual, {
        read_model_row_presence: 'included',
        rag_projection_class: 'candidate_only',
        student_display_class: 'candidate_only',
        accepted_truth_allowed: false,
      }),
    ].sort((left, right) => (left.case_id < right.case_id ? -1 : left.case_id > right.case_id ? 1 : 0)),
```
